segments.ja317:1.1: Mataṃ mataṃ eva [matamatameva (sī. syā. pī.)] rodatha, na hi taṃ rodatha yo marissati;
segments.ja317:1.3: Sabbepi [sabbeva (sī. syā. pī.)] sarīradhārino, anupubbena jahanti jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja317:2.1: Devamanussā catuppadā, pakkhigaṇā uragā ca bhogino;
segments.ja317:2.3: Samhi [yamhi (syā.), asmiṃ (pī. ka.)] sarīre anissarā, ramamānāva jahanti jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja317:4.1: Dhuttā ca soṇḍā [dhuttā soṇḍā (sī.), dhuttā soṇḍā ca (syā.)] akatā, bālā sūrā ayogino [bālā sūrā vīrā ayogino (pī.)];
segments.ja317:4.3: Dhīraṃ maññanti bāloti, ye dhammassa akovidāti.
